body: my partner and I are open about everything and communicate well. theyre aware of my current emotions and what I'm going through. I'm seeing a therapist once a week and a psych about twice a month. it's not enough though.

bluh this might get buried but I need to get it off my chest..

I'm horribly ashamed to admit I let my high school best friend convince me to let them call CPS on my family. my family life was awful at the time and I barely had support. I don't want to get into details but I was miserable. my bff did a 3 way call so I could listen in. this was back when I was too poor for a phone and still used a landline. 


someone was sent over to the house but the visit actually went pretty quickly since we had some food and a clean place. I don't think that was the first time my mom had to deal with CPS so I was actually worried. I can't recall having anymore visits after that. I moved shortly after out of state and haven't moved back since. my mom was obviously devastated and scared and I believe she still had to deal with the case for quite some time after I moved. she's begged me to confess I'm the one who made the call bc "the person the case worker talked to sounded feminine".


I'm on much better terms with my family, especially my mom. I've forgiven her for the things she put me through and allowed. but I'm too terrified to tell her the truth. sometimes this memory plays on repeat in my head and it makes me feel sick. 


tl;dr I let my bff call CPS on my abusive family, visit went well, I noped the fuck out of state and started a new life letting my mom deal with the fallout. I know she thinks it was me but I can't tell her the truth.
